description: This file defines a set of React components encapsulating and customizing Radix UI's Sheets (dialog side panels). It provides components like Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetClose, SheetContent, and layout components such as SheetHeader, SheetFooter, etc., for building a consistent sheet UI pattern with styling and animation.

methods.name: Sheet
methods.description: Main component wrapping Radix UI's Root, passing props and setting a custom data-slot.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component wrapping Radix UI's Trigger, forwarding props with a custom data-slot.

methods.name: SheetClose
methods.description: Component wrapping Radix UI's Close, forwarding props with a custom data-slot.

methods.name: SheetPortal
methods.description: Component wrapping Radix UI's Portal to render the sheet outside of parent hierarchy.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation for sheet background.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Content component that combines portal and overlay, with styling for different sides.

methods.name: SheetHeader
methods.description: Layout component for sheet header section.

methods.name: SheetFooter
methods.description: Layout component for sheet footer section.
